finalText:
All 40 tests pass. Root cause: **double rounding error**.

Bug was lines 24 and 27 — code rounded after each coupon before currency conversion. When coupons stack:
1. Percent coupon applied → rounded to 2 decimals (loss of precision)
2. Flat coupon applied to already-rounded amount → more precision loss
3. Convert to target currency (multiplies accumulated error)
4. Final round (can't recover lost precision)

Reference implementation was correct — only round once at the very end. Fix removed the intermediate rounding. Verified: all 40 tests across 5 currencies and 4 coupon combinations now pass.
